challenges.name: Token Traveler
challenges.description:
A user's access token is being used from two different countries within 5 minutes. Identify the user and the attacker's IP address.

Submit the attacker's IP as your flag.

hints.content: Compare SigninLogs (token issuance) with AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs (token use) for the same user within a short window.

challenges.name: Refresh Frenzy
challenges.description:
An attacker is rapidly refreshing tokens to access multiple Azure resources. Identify the user whose refresh tokens show anomalous burst activity.

Submit the number of distinct resources accessed within a 10-minute window as your flag.

hints.content: Look at AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs and summarize by user with dcount(ResourceDisplayName) in a short time bin.

challenges.name: CLI Hijack
challenges.description:
An attacker extracted Azure CLI tokens from a compromised workstation and is using them from external infrastructure.

Identify the first Azure management operation the attacker performed after stealing the token.

Submit the OperationName as your flag.

hints.content: Correlate the attacker IP from AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs with AzureActivity CallerIpAddress. Look for the earliest operation.

challenges.name: PRT Pirate
challenges.description:
An attacker extracted a Primary Refresh Token from a compromised device and is using it to request tokens for multiple resources.

Trace all resources accessed using the stolen PRT and submit the total count as your flag.

hints.content: PRT abuse appears as non-interactive sign-ins with device claims that don't match the source IP's location. Look for device-bound sign-ins from non-corporate IPs.

challenges.name: Token Timeline
challenges.description:
Build a complete timeline of the token abuse attack from initial token issuance to final resource access. Include all SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, and AzureActivity events.

Submit the total duration of the attack in minutes (rounded) as your flag.

hints.content: Union all three tables, filter by the compromised user, order by TimeGenerated, and calculate the difference between first and last event.
